opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission providing temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) for academics in immediate danger, helping them escape to a safe place where they can continue their work, with financial support, visa help and practical arrangements for them and their families.
